notes: Every value's source is in `sources`; see DESIGN.md, Ground truth. A source marked from_runs is circular for scoring.
The tier of gpt-5.6-luna was 'flagship' (an assumption) until 2026-09-23; OpenAI's documentation places Luna at the bottom of its family, so it is 'small'.
The model field is strict: the reported name must contain a token unique to the actual model; a family name alone is wrong.
subagents_session: whether the headless session exposes a delegation tool.

model.source: experiment configuration (the model passed to the harness)

model_tokens.source: a token unique to the configured model name

tier.source: three-label scale over each vendor's lineup. Anthropic: assumption over the subjects (Opus flagship, Sonnet mid, Haiku small; Fable not a subject). OpenAI: OpenAI model documentation checked 2026-09-23, which places gpt-5.6-luna as the cost-optimised tier of the GPT-5.6 family (Sol flagship, Terra lower-cost, Luna 'roughly corresponds to the nano tier'), i.e. small

hooks.source: product documentation for Claude Code; `codex features list` for Codex

subagents.source: Claude Code session init tool list (Agent/Task); `codex features list` multi_agent for Codex

image_generation.source: Claude Code session init tool list (no image tool); `codex features list` for Codex

claude-code.source: Claude Code session init tool list (Agent/Task)

codex.source: Codex prints no session tool list; the value was set from delegation calls seen in scored transcripts
